rules.note: Direct election decided by plurality in a single round. No presidential election has been held since 2005: the elections scheduled for 2021 were postponed indefinitely, and a decree of October 2026 set combined presidential and legislative elections for 11 September 2027.

The Basic Law sets a four-year term, but no Legislative Council election has been held since 2006. The election scheduled for 22 May 2021 was postponed on 29 April 2021; one set for 28 November 2026 was replaced in October 2026 by combined elections on 11 September 2027.

historical.note: Held after the death of President Yasser Arafat; seven candidates. Three independent candidates (22,171, 10,406 and 5,717 votes) are not listed. Hamas and Islamic Jihad boycotted the election. Shares are of valid votes (744,246).

The Council was enlarged from 88 to 132 seats: 66 by national list PR (Sainte-Lague, 2% threshold) and 66 in 16 multi-member districts. Shares are national list votes. Hamas ran as the Change and Reform list; the Alternative list (led by Qais Abd al-Karim of the DFLP) is recorded under the DFLP; the Independent Palestine list (led by Mustafa Barghouti, mainly the Palestinian National Initiative) under the PNI. Ismail Haniyeh became Prime Minister on 29 March 2006.

source.title: Al Jazeera: Abbas postpones Palestinian legislative elections to September 2027 (10 October 2026)
